subject: Phased reintegration request for Priya Natarajan - flexible schedule and coverage
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: phased reintegration + attached note

Hi Ava / Laura / Marcus,

Thanks for the flexibility while I finished treatment. My doctor has cleared me to return to work with a phased schedule starting the week of Nov 23. I attached the note from Dr. Ortiz (doctor_note_priya_morales.pdf).

Request summary:
- Target return date: Monday, 2026-11-23
- Accommodation request: 4-week phased reintegration with reduced meeting load and remote-first schedule the first two weeks
- Proposed weekly cadence (flexible to adjust):
  * Week 1 (11/23): 3 days (Mon/Wed/Fri) - 4 hours/day, no recurring all-hands or cross-team meetings
  * Week 2 (11/30): 4 days - 6 hours/day, limited meetings (no >60 min meetings)
  * Week 3 (12/07): 5 days - full day, reduced meetings first half of week
  * Week 4 (12/14): full responsibilities, normal cadence

I can be in the office on the days Marcus and I agree are best for pairing. If any of this is an issue please let me know — my priority is a gradual ramp so I can sustain the workload.

Action items I know of: submit RTW form, confirm schedule, identify short-term coverage for outgoing on-call and a couple of high-priority tickets.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: doctor_note_priya_morales.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: phased reintegration + attached note

Hi Priya — welcome back and thank you for the thorough note. I reviewed the doctor note and the plan you proposed looks reasonable.

I've attached a quick template (phased_schedule_template.xlsx) with the same four-week structure and a column for days in-office vs remote so we can lock down specifics. A few clarifying questions before we finalize:
1) Are there any restrictions on driving or public transit for the first two weeks?
2) Any activities (e.g., on-call rotations, PR reviews) you need to defer until week 3 or 4?
3) Preferred days in-office for pairing? Marcus / team please confirm coverage for Thu on-call for the first two weeks.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync on Tue 2026-11-10 at 10:00 AM PT to finalize the schedule and sign HR paperwork. If that works for everyone, I'll send a calendar invite and add the RTW form link.

Thanks — I'll also prep a short summary for peopleops so the formal record is in place.

Best,
Ava
People Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: phased_schedule_template.xlsx
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: phased reintegration + attached note

On Sat, Nov 7, 2026 at 11:05 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Priya — welcome back and thank you for the thorough note. I reviewed the doctor note and the plan you proposed looks reasonable.
>
> I've attached a quick template (phased_schedule_template.xlsx) with the same four-week structure and a column for days in-office vs remote so we can lock down specifics.

Thanks, Ava — that time for the sync works for me. Quick answers inline: 
- No driving restrictions — I can commute when needed, but would prefer 2 days in-office per week for the first two weeks (Mon + Wed).
- On-call: I can be removed from on-call for Weeks 1–2; Marcus, would you be able to cover Thu on-call and take handoff notes?
- PR reviews: feel free to route high-priority reviews to my deputy (Rohan) for Weeks 1–2; I can do async comments up to 24 hours delay.

I'll bring the signed doctor's note to the meeting and will fill out the online RTW form after the sync.

— Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood RTW form & next steps

Hi Priya / Ava / Marcus,

Thanks for confirming. I've created the formal RTW record and attached the company form (redwood_return_to_work_form.docx). Please complete and e-sign the RTW form within 72 hours after your sync; the DocuSign link is below. Once completed, we'll update payroll and calendar accommodations.

DocuSign (RTW & accommodations): https://docusign.com/placeholder/abc123
Internal policy reference: https://redwood-internal.company/hr/forms/rtw-2026

Confidentiality note: we will only share limited accommodation details with the immediate team (Marcus + tech leads) and People Ops. If there are any specific privacy requests, note them on the form and we'll honor them.

If you need any additional workplace adjustments (e.g., chair, monitor stand), let me know and I'll route to facilities.

Thanks,
Laura
Sr. People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_return_to_work_form.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 22:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: phased reintegration + attached note

Priya — thanks for the clear plan and welcome back. I'll cover Thu on-call for Weeks 1–2 and will reassign the highest-priority tickets to Rohan as you suggested. A few quick operational notes so handoffs are clean:
- I'll create a short on-call runbook entry for Thu that lists the two tickets to prioritize.
- I'll schedule 30-min pairing blocks on Mon/Wed for Week 1 to help unblock any environment or infra issues.
- For deadlines in the next two sprints, I'll push out one non-critical deadline by one sprint to reduce immediate context-switching.

Confirmed: I will join the Tue 11/10 sync and we'll finalize the in-office days. If anything changes on the accommodation side, loop in Ava and Laura and we'll update the plan.

— Marcus
